EmailTemplate.name: TQL SLA Expired
EmailTemplate.subject: Please update the status of your TQL lead
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Lead.OwnerFirstName},
The lead {!Lead.Name} from {!Lead.Company} assigned to you or accepted by you has not been updated to the status of Accepted, Passed to Partner, or Rejected within the specified SLA. Click here to visit this lead record in SFDC
As a reminder, the following SLA’s are expected for any TQL lead: LDR must schedule 1-on-1 connect with relevant Sales Rep within 1 business day of <Entrance Date – TQL.> The meeting itself does not need to be within 1 business day, however it is encouraged to be as close as possible, barring schedules. Please disposition your lead by scheduling this 1-on-1 with the relevant sales rep, and reassign the lead to the appropriate Sales Rep as required. Thank you.
